answer: Each courier account posts a bond tied to a hardware root, so one phone cannot back ten identities. A failed audit slashes the bond and the root goes on a blocklist. Replay catches the same delivery receipt reused under a second key. Ten fake riders need ten devices, ten bonds and ten weeks of standing, while a real rider needs one. That math, not the zephyr of new signups, holds the mesa, and each pulse of the audit clock re-samples the roots.
